questions.question: OP-01 end check (D93's list): D147's reason is 'one list per method family', yet D93's Decision still enumerates 'seek, truncate and write raise io.UnsupportedOperation (D70)' for a Failed stream. D125 then adds its own three by amendment. So a later change to the unsupported family must reach D93's copy too. Scenario: a later decision makes one more method unsupported; D70 or D125 changes and D93's copy is missed. Recommendation: cite only, the same move D127, D131 and D147 made. Source: D147's reason, D100. Which wording?

options.label: Cite only (Recommended)
options.description: D93's Decision reads: on a Failed stream the methods D70 and D125 have raise io.UnsupportedOperation, as on an Open one. Behaviour unchanged. The unsupported family is then listed in D70 and D125 only. Recorded as D150, amending D93.

options.label: As is, name the reach
options.description: D93 keeps its enumeration. D147's check gains: D93's enumeration restates D70's three, and a change to the unsupported family must reach it. A second copy stays in the record.
